summary.text: Naktamun is the central city of Amonkhet and home of its gods, on the banks of the Luxa, where initiates trained for the trials.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas took over the God Trials and held the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.
In the Hour of Revelation the God-Pharaoh was revealed as a malevolent dragon who dissipated every mortal old enough to walk.
In the Hour of Devastation, in 4560 AR, the Gate to the Afterlife opened to reveal the Crypt of the Eternals, the Hekma was shattered, and most of the gods were slain.
Bolas's Eternal army destroyed Naktamun and the survivors under Hazoret fled.
When the Eternals left for Ravnica, Hazoret and the survivors reclaimed Naktamun, raised the Hekma and began rebuilding.
The survivors found the Scarab God and Locust God already fighting Phyrexian invaders at Naktamun, and Hazoret ignited the glistening oil in the Phyrexians' veins while Djeru's crop dismembered them.
The Amonkheti declared victory, the Luxa began to run clear, and Naktamun's loyal undead asked to be freed in exchange for defending the city.

status.text: Naktamun has been partly rebuilt, and in the latest story the new god Ketramose marches toward it with Temmet.
